title: 第4章 重生(2)
content_zh:
谷雨和惊蛰面面相觑，最后还是惊蛰去取了一面镜子递给沈妙。
铜镜里，少女脸儿圆圆，额头饱满，一双大大的杏眼微微发红，鼻头圆润，嘴巴小小。还是一张未脱稚气的脸，说不上多美貌，却胜在清新可爱，乖巧羞怯的模样。
那是一张曾被皇家人盛赞“旺夫”之相的少女容颜。
沈妙手中的镜子猝然落地，发出清脆的响声，碎片的声音击打在她心中，掀起巨大的惊涛骇浪。
她狠狠的掐了一把自己，两行热泪滚滚而下。
苍天不负人，苍天不负她！
她回来了！
谷雨和惊蛰吓了一跳，谷雨忙去捡地上的碎片，焦急道：“姑娘仔细莫扎了脚。”
“姑娘怎么哭了？”惊蛰拿着帕子给沈妙擦脸，却见沈妙神情诡异，似哭似笑，嘴里喃喃道：“我回来了……”
她一把抓住惊蛰：“现在是多少年？”

惊蛰有些害怕，却还是老老实实回答：“明齐六十八年。姑娘是怎么了？觉得身子不舒服么？”
“明齐六十八年，明齐六十八年……”沈妙瞪大眼睛，明齐六十八年，她十四岁那年，是她遇到傅修宜，痴恋傅修宜，甚至向父亲逼嫁，请求嫁给傅修宜的那一年！
而现在……她的耳中响起谷雨的话：“姑娘莫要吓奴婢们，这才将将退了热，莫不是神智有些不清楚，大姑娘也实在太狠了，这不是要了姑娘的命嘛……”
沈妙上辈子大多时间都跟在傅修宜身边为他奔走，在沈府的日子过的却是毫无滋味。这件事她却记得清楚，和傅修宜有关的每件事她都记得清楚。
沈清告诉她傅修宜要来沈府拜访二叔和三叔，拉她一起偷偷去瞧，待到了花园，沈清却把她从假山上推了下去。
湿淋淋的从池塘里被捞上来，当时一同在的还有别的官员同僚，只当是看了沈府的笑话。她迷恋定王的事情早在半年前就传遍了京城，这一次，不过是徒增笑料。
上辈子，她醒来后指责沈清将她推下池塘，偏没有一个人信任她，沈妙委屈的不得了，被老夫人罚禁足佛堂，导致之后的中秋没法出门，沈玥偷偷将她放出来，带她一同去了雁北堂的赏菊宴，出了十足洋相。
沈妙闭了闭眼。
沈家有三房，大房沈信，就是沈妙的父亲，是老将军原配的儿子。原配中年病逝，老将军娶了门继室，继室生了二房沈贵和三房沈万。老将军死后，继室成了如今的老夫人，沈家没有分家，兄弟三人相互扶持，感情颇好，传为一段佳话。

沈家世代戎马，到了沈信这一代，除了大房手握兵权，二房和三房却是走文官的路子。沈信常年在外征战，沈夫人也跟着丈夫随军，沈妙就一直被放在沈府，老夫人和两个婶婶亲自教导。
教导来教导去，就成了这么一副一事无成，不学无术，遇见男人就不知羞耻的黏上去的草包。
前一世，她只觉得婶婶和老夫人待她特别好，沈玥和沈清要学的规矩礼仪，她统统不必学。如今看来，不过是一出十足蹩脚的捧杀。
欺她父母兄长不在身边，便当面一套背面一套，只让沈信和沈夫人每次回府都觉得，这个女儿比从前更加顽劣草包了一些罢了。
这一世，她倒要看看，这些人要如何厚颜无耻的故技重施！
正想着，便听到外头洒扫院子的丫头跑了进来，道：“姑娘，二姑娘来看你了。”
content_en:
Guyu and Jingzhe looked at each other, and finally Jingzhe went to get a mirror and handed it to Shen Miao.
In the bronze mirror, the girl has a round face, a full forehead, a pair of big almond-shaped eyes that are slightly red, a round nose, and a small mouth. She still has a childish face, which cannot be said to be beautiful, but is better than fresh, cute, well-behaved and shy.
It was the face of a girl who had been highly praised by the royal family for her "prosperous" appearance.
The mirror in Shen Miao's hand suddenly fell to the ground, making a crisp sound. The sound of fragments hit her heart, causing a huge storm.
She pinched herself hard, and tears rolled down her face.
Heaven will not fail you, Heaven will not fail you!
She's back!
Guyu and Jingzhe were startled. Guyu hurriedly picked up the fragments on the ground and said anxiously: "Miss Mo pricked her feet carefully."
"Why are you crying, girl?" Jingzhe wiped Shen Miao's face with a handkerchief, but saw that Shen Miao had a strange look on her face, as if she was crying and laughing at the same time, and murmured: "I'm back..."
She grabbed Jingzhe and asked, "How old is it now?"

Jingzhe was a little scared, but she still answered honestly: "In the 68th year of Ming Qi. What's wrong with the girl? Do you feel uncomfortable?"
"The sixty-eighth year of Mingqi, the sixty-eighth year of Mingqi..." Shen Miao's eyes widened. In the sixty-eighth year of Mingqi, when she was fourteen years old, it was the year when she met Fu Xiuyi, fell in love with Fu Xiuyi, and even forced her father to marry him and asked to marry Fu Xiuyi!
And now... Gu Yu's words rang in her ears: "Girl, please don't scare the slaves. Only then will the fever subside. Could it be that your mind is a little unclear? The eldest girl is too cruel. Wouldn't this cost the girl's life..."
Shen Miao spent most of her previous life by Fu Xiu Yi's side and running for him, but her life in the Shen Mansion was tasteless. But she remembered this matter clearly, and she remembered everything related to Fu Xiuyi clearly.
Shen Qing told her that Fu Xiuyi was coming to the Shen Mansion to visit his second and third uncles, and asked her to secretly take a look. When they arrived at the garden, Shen Qing pushed her off the rockery.
He was fished out of the pond dripping wet. There were other officials and colleagues who were with him at the time, and they just thought they were watching Shen's family's joke. Her obsession with Prince Ding had spread throughout the capital half a year ago. This time, it was just a joke.
In her previous life, after she woke up, she accused Shen Qing of pushing her into the pond, but no one believed her. Shen Miao felt extremely wronged and was punished by the old lady and was banned from the Buddhist hall. As a result, she was unable to go out during the Mid-Autumn Festival. Shen Yue secretly released her and took her to the chrysanthemum appreciation banquet in Yanbeitang, making a complete fool of herself.
Shen Miao closed her eyes.
The Shen family has three rooms. The eldest room is Shen Xin, who is Shen Miao's father and the son of the old general's first wife. The first wife died of illness in middle age, and the old general married his second wife, who gave birth to his second wife Shen Gui and his third wife Shen Wan. After the death of the old general, his stepmother became the current old lady. The Shen family was not divided. The three brothers supported each other and had a good relationship, which became a good story.
The Shen family has been involved in the military for generations, but in Shen Xin's generation, except for the first eldest brother who holds military power, the second and third eldest brothers are civil servants. Shen Xin was away fighting all the year round, and Mrs. Shen also followed her husband in the army. Shen Miao was always kept in the Shen Mansion, and the old lady and her two aunts taught her personally.
After being taught again and again, he has become such a useless idiot who has accomplished nothing, knows no skills, and shamelessly clings to men when he meets them.
In the previous life, she only felt that her aunt and the old lady treated her very well. She didn't have to learn any of the rules and etiquette that Shen Yue and Shen Qing had to learn. Now it seems that it is just a completely lame flattery.
Shen Xin and Mrs. Shen felt that every time they returned home, this daughter was even more naughty and useless than before.
In this life, she would like to see how thick these people areShamelessly repeating his old tricks!
Just as I was thinking about it, I heard the girl who was cleaning the yard outside running in and said, "Girl, the second girl is here to see you."
